instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Waste-to-energy facility processing 180,000 tons of municipal solid waste annually, generating 15 MW of baseload electricity. Evaluating advanced flue gas treatment to meet tightening emissions standards and exploring district heating network connection to improve overall plant efficiency. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered “$2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: Aether operates primarily in a stable regulatory environment but faces intense competition from decentralized energy providers and new recycling technologies. The primary focus is on leveraging existing assets for non-core revenue streams to ensure long-term viability.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: AI-driven Predictive Maintenance for Flue Gas Systems
opportunities.rationale: Given the conservative risk profile and short time horizon, implementing AI diagnostics on existing flue gas treatment systems offers immediate operational efficiency gains without requiring a radical overhaul of core infrastructure. This leverages existing data warehouse assets.

first_actions: Pilot predictive maintenance software on one critical boiler unit
Identify and secure relevant IoT sensor hardware budget
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned downtime by 15% within 6 months

opportunities.title: Micro-Grid Energy Brokerage Service
opportunities.rationale: To achieve strategic diversification, Aether should explore developing a short-term service using its existing energy infrastructure to facilitate peer-to-peer energy trading or micro-grid connections for local commercial clients. This moves the company into adjacent markets and leverages operational capabilities.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on third-party grid integration standards
Identify a small pilot partner in a local commercial district
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying pilot contracts by year-end
milestones: Q1: Feasibility and partnership agreement signed
Q2: Beta service launch in limited geography

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed competitive analysis of adjacent energy service providers.
Finalize scope and resource allocation for the Micro-Grid Brokerage pilot (radical opportunity).

key_weaknesses: Siloed integration between core ERP/Data Warehouse and new innovation projects.
High time commitment required from existing staff, limiting bandwidth for long-term radical R&D.
Internal cultural resistance to rapid experimentation outside established operational parameters.
Limited budget (3%) severely restricts the scope of truly disruptive R&D initiatives.
